ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 98% of the visible surface area. Limited high-intensity (white) pixel localized to small-scale scars and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes. No macro-level contiguous white blobs present. Discrete, high-contrast white points of interest are mapped in scattered patterns across the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled U-shaped depression centrally located between lobes; estimated pixel angle between 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes. Significant jaggedness observed on the distal half of both trailing edges, transitioning to smoother contours near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white clusters distributed across the central surface of both lobes, including a distinct grouping of approximately three circular marks on the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, including two parallel vertical marks in the lower quadrant and a single diagonal mark in the upper quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of calcified biological growths (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Extensive surface scarring including both circular and linear configurations.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged truncation on the upper-right distal edge of the right lobe, deviating from the standard sweep trajectory.
